A 60 day CR that locks in the status quo is dead on arrival in the Senate, and Republicans know it.

We’ve been clear from day one: Democrats will fund critical Homeland Security functions—but we will not give a blank check to Trump’s lawless and deadly immigration militia without reforms.

After weeks of negotiations, Republicans caved to our demands to fund DHS without a blank check for ICE and CBP. 

My full statement below:

Senate Republicans are once again wasting time on voter suppression with an amendment to the SAVE Act that would impose the single strictest voter-ID law in America.

This amendment would undo the sacred secrecy of our ballots. 

Democrats won't let it happen.

99% of the SAVE Act isn't about voter ID, but about kicking 20 million American citizens off the voter rolls and making re-registering a bureaucratic nightmare.

Trump and Republicans only want people who agree with them to be able to vote.

Not on our watch.

Trump promised lower energy bills. Instead, they skyrocketed.

Democrats’ plan to bring them down:
1. Build more clean energy
2. Cut delays — not protections
3. Fix the grid
4. Make data centers pay their fair share
5. Protect consumers

nytimes.com/2026/03/25/clima…

Donald Trump is lifting sanctions on Iran, giving them $14 billion in the process, all to try to solve an energy prices problem that was created by his reckless war in the first place. 

@SenateGOP used to sound the alarm about this type of action. 

Now? Silence.

2.5 million people kicked off SNAP in less than a year. The most vulnerable among us.
 
All while Trump skyrockets prices across the board with his aimless war.
 
Everything @POTUS does is America and Americans last.


Katie Bergh (@Katie_Bergh)

This time will be no different than the last two.


Kaitlan Collins (@kaitlancollins)

Americans are already skipping meals thanks to Trump’s reckless war of choice in Iran, and this is just another example of how his chaos is making it harder to afford food.

As Trump’s heartless SNAP cuts go into effect over the next year, the lowest income families will only struggle more to feed their kids as prices rise.

If Republicans want to shove the SAVE Act into reconciliation, then have at it.
 
Democrats will fight it tooth and nail, every step of the way. They're going to find it very difficult to jam these massive changes to the American election system.

Today, for the TENTH TIME, Democrats will go to the floor to demand that we pay TSA immediately. 
 
And for the TENTH TIME, Republicans will have a chance to join us. I’m not holding my breath.
